summary: Registers the media types application/gzip and application/zlib for data compressed with the gzip and zlib formats. This lets protocols and software label such content properly. It is informational and not an Internet Standards Track specification.

eli5.summary: When you send a zipped package, the label on the box should say how it was packed. This memo creates the official labels for two common ways of squishing data.

questions: what is the application/gzip media type
